note: Fixed-input microtimings only. No generation/ranking-quality claim or full500 gate. Repeated observations are not independent users. Inspect useful benefit before a separately scoped generation pilot.
timing_boundary: CUDA-event averages of 32 frozen graph replays; eight rounds. Excludes staging, backend selection, setup/capture, profiler/logging and extraction. Not generation-call latency.
decision: Reject global cuBLASLt preference: all12 original down projections change FP32 bits and are slower in median and p95. Gate/up are exact with the same observed kernel/grid and only small, inconsistent timing differences. No generation pilot/full500 or tuning sweep. Keep accepted folded baseline and reassess score-fidelity versus quality tradeoffs with the user.
